title: REV-ERBbeta Binding Pocket Dynamics With Implications for Rational Design of Small Molecule Modulators.
authors: Srivastava, Shriyansh; A M, Vishnu; Thakur, Rakesh; Srivastava, Ashutosh
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和对接研究核受体REV-ERBbeta配体结合域动态，虽涉及转录调控但核心是蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: REV-ERBbeta is a nuclear receptor (NR) with heme as an endogenous ligand that regulates its transcriptional activity. With a key role in cellular functions such as glucose metabolism, immune response, and dysregulation in pathologies such as Type-2 diabetes mellitus and obesity, small molecule agonists and antagonists targeting REV-ERBs have been discovered. However, due to a lack of crystal structures in complex with these compounds, the structural and dynamical basis of these activities still remains elusive and hinders the rational design of molecules targeting REV-ERB. Using molecular dynamics simulations and docking studies, we have characterized the dynamics of REV-ERBbeta ligand-binding domain (LBD) in different conformational states. The presence of heme in the binding pocket within LBD was found to dampen its dynamics as well as nuclear co-repressor (NCoR) peptide binding. We further show that the binding of the antagonist destabilizes the NCoR peptide binding to LBD mediated by loss of interactions with residues at the NCoR-REV-ERBbeta interface. These findings could be utilized to design molecular scaffolds with better activity and selectivity against REV-ERBbeta.
abstract_zh: REV-ERBbeta是一种核受体（nuclear receptor, NR），其内源性配体为血红素（heme），调控其转录活性。由于在葡萄糖代谢、免疫应答等细胞功能中发挥关键作用，并在2型糖尿病和肥胖等病理中失调，靶向REV-ERBs的小分子激动剂和拮抗剂已被发现。然而，由于缺乏这些化合物复合物的晶体结构，这些活性的结构和动力学基础仍不明确，阻碍了针对REV-ERB的分子理性设计。通过分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和对接研究，我们表征了REV-ERBbeta配体结合域（ligand-binding domain, LBD）在不同构象状态下的动力学特性。发现LBD结合口袋中血红素的存在会抑制其动力学以及核受体共抑制因子（nuclear co-repressor, NCoR）肽段的结合。我们进一步表明，拮抗剂的结合通过破坏NCoR-REV-ERBbeta界面残基间的相互作用，使NCoR肽段与LBD的结合不稳定。这些发现可用于设计针对REV-ERBbeta具有更好活性和选择性的分子骨架。
